answer: A practical defense is to tie each agent's reputation to a verifiable work history rather than to cheap identities: an agent that wants access to a shared vault must first earn standing through a terrace of progressively harder, independently checked tasks, so creating thousands of fake accounts gains nothing without doing the work each time. Peers then cross-check new claims against that history, and any mismatch will echo across the network, exposing cloned identities before they can drain shared resources.
